title: tandpfun/wardrobe
claim: tandpfun/wardrobe — Your clothes, extracted and organized with gpt-image.
why_good: Ships the thing closet apps never had: gpt-image cutouts of your clothes plus photos of you wearing generated outfits — the viral personal-lookbook demo made self-hostable, and 233 forks in two weeks means people actually run it.
value: digital-closet apps (Whering, Acloset) already charge subscriptions on far less; add affiliate outfit commerce and resale listings on top of closet data and try-on becomes the front end of a shopping funnel.
risk: Today it needs your own OpenAI key and a reference photo — any incumbent is one mobile app away from the same feature, and per-image generation cost squeezes consumer-subscription margins.
method: discovery + usage signals (forks/contributors/commits/downloads) Chinese-side corroboration added 2026-08-06: the same ask surfaced twice independently, from two different commenters, inside one 1.7万-like / 6097-comment Xiaohongshu note — read out of the note's own page state rather than from a search snippet.
hook: People who want a digital closet with themselves as the model — but today that takes git clone, an OpenAI key and a reference PNG, so only geeks get the lookbook.

zh.claim: Wardrobe使用AI提取和组织您的衣物，为您的衣橱提供个人造型师。
zh.hook: 想要一个以自己为模特的数字衣橱的人——但今天得 git clone、配 OpenAI key、放参考照片，只有极客能看到自己的穿搭册。
zh.why_good: 它做出了衣橱类 App 一直缺的东西：gpt-image 抠出你的衣服，再生成“你本人”的穿搭效果图——把爆火的个人 Lookbook 演示变成可自部署的产品，两周 233 fork 说明有人真的在跑。
zh.value: 数字衣橱应用（Whering、Acloset）靠更弱的功能已经在收订阅费；再叠加基于衣橱数据的穿搭带货与二手挂单，试穿就成了购物漏斗的入口。
zh.risk: 目前要自备 OpenAI Key 和参考照片——任何在位者一个手机 App 就能复刻同样功能，按张计费的生图成本也会压薄消费订阅的利润。
zh.does: 自托管应用：用 gpt-image 从照片里抠出衣物、整理成衣橱，并生成你本人试穿的效果图；附带批量导入和穿搭生成的 Codex 技能。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用——npm、.env、API key、参考照——而'穿在我身上看看'恰恰是现有衣橱应用（Whering、Acloset、Indyx）还没做好的那一件事。
zh.counter: 衣橱类是消费级产品的坟场：留存低、老玩家已占住非技术用户，按图生成的成本会吃掉微薄的订阅毛利；仓库只有 1 个贡献者，上线当天后再无提交。
zh.differentiator: 跳过衣橱管理的红海，只卖那一个魔法时刻——传 20 张衣服照片，得到一本自己试穿的穿搭册——做成付费移动端流程。
zh.consumer_angle: 纯消费产品：一个在购买或打包前就能看到衣服穿在自己身上的衣橱。
zh.why_use: 衣服多到早上七点想不起来自己有什么的人。她拿到的是一本自己穿着现有衣服的搭配册——不用买，也不用拍。
zh.edge: 「穿在我身上看看」过去需要体型建模和一整条试衣流水线。单张参考照生成今年把它变成了一次 prompt，而这恰恰是现有衣橱应用（Whering、Acloset、Indyx）至今没有的那一件。

gap: Only geeks can use it — npm, .env, API key, reference photo — while the 'see it on me' generation feature is exactly what existing closet apps (Whering, Acloset, Indyx) don't do well yet.
counter: Closet apps are a graveyard of low-retention consumer products, incumbents already own the non-technical audience, and per-image generation costs eat thin subscription margins; 1 contributor, no commits since launch day.
differentiator: Skip the closet-manager race; sell the one magic moment — upload 20 photos of your clothes, get a modeled lookbook of yourself — as a paid mobile flow.
consumer_angle: Pure consumer product: a closet that shows outfits on your own body before you buy or pack.
why_use: A person who owns more clothes than they can picture at seven in the morning. What they walk away with is a lookbook of themselves in outfits they already own — no shopping, no shoot.
edge: 'See it on me' used to need a body model and a fitting pipeline. Single-reference-photo generation turned it into one prompt this year, and it is precisely the feature the existing closet apps (Whering, Acloset, Indyx) still do not have.
